from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, subprocess, tempfile, json
site=Path("products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example/")
root=Path("products/distribution/catalogue-editor-example-placement/")
handoff=root/'release-owner-handoff'
baseline=root/'placement-live-readback.html'
manifest=json.loads((handoff/'verification.json').read_text())
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
current=(site/'index.html').read_bytes()
assert sha(current)==manifest['concurrent_draft_sha256']
assert sha(baseline.read_bytes())==manifest['served_sha256']
expected=manifest['current_draft_other_files_sha256']
assert {str(f.relative_to(site)):sha(f.read_bytes()) for f in site.rglob('*') if f.is_file() and f!=site/'index.html'}==expected
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    candidate=Path(tmp)/'index.html'
    candidate.write_bytes(baseline.read_bytes())
    subprocess.run(['patch','--batch','--forward',str(candidate),str(handoff/'worked-example-only.diff')],check=True)
    payload=candidate.read_bytes()
assert sha(payload)==manifest['worked_example_index_sha256']
(handoff/'preserved-concurrent-index.html').write_bytes(current)
(site/'index.html').write_bytes(payload)
print(json.dumps({'staged':sha(payload),'preserved':sha(current),'files':1+len(expected)}))
